ValidationRule.description: External follow-ups may only move to Sent from Approved (or a failed send of an approved message).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Sent"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Audience__c, "Internal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Send_Failed")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A client or provider follow-up can only be sent after it has been approved.
